calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-18-2003 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Names.
Commissioner Sue Kaplan, Clerks: S. Ravinantapricha/M. Vallejo, CSR: Leslie Schneider.
Petitioner: Minh Van Nguyen present in pro per and also present for the minors, Patrick Tuan Lee and Sophia Phuong Le, was sworn and examined.
The Court grants the petition for change of name to: Minh Tich Vu.
The Court grants the petition for change of the MINOR'S name to: Patrick Tuan Vu.
The Court grants the petition for change of the MINOR'S name to: Sophia Phuong Vu.
Decree signed in open court.
